scope: The six separately named external builds represented in the SL0 portfolio paragraph on the canonical Platform resource.
boundary: Repository and Vercel-account evidence establishes only the dated existence of the recorded private repository or project. A deployment record does not establish current public accessibility, continuous operation, data freshness, client commissioning, client authorization to publish, ownership of third-party material, fitness, or independent validation. Private names and destinations remain non-public unless publication is separately authorized.

records.requiredBoundary: Independent pre-engagement proof of concept; no client relationship, public inspection right, continuous operation, or current-data claim.
